text:
maya_cs: Ok team — StablePool (acct: novae) go-live next Wed 09:00 PT. Need final quota plan + autoscale guardrails. Who's owning load tests and smoke?

raj_ops: I can own the load tests. Plan I have in mind: step load 0 -> 50% -> 100% over ~30m, then a 10m soak, then two 5m burst spikes to 2k rps. Need exact QPS targets from CS.

maya_cs: CS numbers: baseline ~350 rps, expected sustained peak 1.2k rps, short burst ceiling 2k rps for up to 5m. Important: customers use long-context chat, avg seq len ~600 tokens, so token cost and KV cache profiles matter.

eli_sre: Long-context changes batching behavior. Suggest reserved pool sizing: allocate 6x baseline GPUs for first 24h to avoid cold tail latency while we tune autoscale; then scale down per policy. We'll also need KV cache warmup and priming strategy.

cam_devex: Proposed autoscale policy draft: scale step = +2 nodes, cooldown = 3m, burst capacity = +20% via burst token bucket, and add a circuit-breaker: if 95th latency > 1.5s for 2 consecutive windows -> shift traffic to fallback smaller model automatically. Thoughts?

maya_cs: Yes agree. Also want a shadow traffic replay for 2h during off-peak to validate cache keys and tokenizer edge cases. Raj, can you run shadow replay harness and capture KV hitrate + per-seq-token histograms?

raj_ops: Yep — I'll schedule replay Tue 02:00 PT. I need the sanitized request bundle and example long contexts from Novae. @maya_cs please upload sanitized logs to the shared bucket and give me the dataset path.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: reserved-pool allocation requested by @eli_sre for StablePool acct 'novae' — ticket #CS-7891

eli_sre: I'll open ops ticket for autoscale and fallback routing: #OPS-9942. Setting initial KV prefix caching TTL = 2h for the priming run; we'll iterate after the replay metrics.

maya_cs: Concern about cost burn during the 24h overprovisioning window — set alerts for estimated spend/burn-rate. If forecast burn_rate > 120% of budget, trigger automatic rollback to smaller model or enable aggressive caching.

cam_devex: I'll draft a concise runbook and rollback snippet. Pasting quick rollback command for ops:
```bash
# rollback to smaller model routing
redwoodctl model set --routing novae --model gpt-medium-quant --weight 1.0
```

raj_ops: Load test checklist to run Tue: 1) verify 350/1.2k/2k targets; 2) measure 50/95/99 latency and tail behavior; 3) KV cache hitrate and warmup time; 4) GPU memory & utilization; 5) failure injection: rate limit, node OOM, network flaps. Capture logs + perf traces.

maya_cs: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate Novae PM/engineer to be on-standby during tests and confirm KMS access and any PII gating on dataset.

eli_sre: Extra safety: enable canary routing for first 2 hours with 10% traffic, automatic fallback if error rate > 1% or latency SLO breached. Also add per-route token-level billing alarm.

maya_cs: Good. Final ask: capture qualitative feedback from Novae during the dry-run. I'll send them a 3-question checklist (any surprising latencies, any incorrect behaviors, any cost concerns) and attach responses to CS ticket.

cam_devex: :memo: I'll attach the playbook + checklist to #CS-7891 and link OPS-9942. Leaving a short troubleshooting cheat-sheet in that ticket as well.

raj_ops: I'll post a brief summary in this thread after the replay run with the key metrics and any anomalies.

maya_cs: Thanks all — sync at 08:00 PT day of to confirm greenlight.
